t: The Xtend+Climb ProSeries S2 is a professional telescopic ladder, engineered from aircraft-grade aluminium for strength and enduring performance. It offers a compact and reliable access solution, ideal for tradespeople working in confined spaces or needing easy transport between job sites. The True Telescopic technology includes an automatic deployable stabiliser bar, providing a wide 620mm base for stability. Smooth Lightning Latch retraction and green rung-lock indicators facilitate quick and safe setup and storage. A No-Pinch Closure System and anti-slip feet enhance user safety during operation. This ladder has a maximum static vertical load of 150kg and a corrosion-resistant anodised finish.
